preconditions.description: The input string length is between 5 and 10,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in stdin.strip())
preconditions.description: The input string consists only of lowercase English letters.

postconditions.description: The first line of output is an integer k, equal to the number of distinct valid suffixes.

postconditions.expression: all(len(suffix) in {2, 3} for suffix in suffixes)
postconditions.description: Each suffix in the output has length 2 or 3.

postconditions.expression: all(suffix in possible_suffixes for suffix in suffixes)
postconditions.description: Each suffix in the output is a valid suffix according to the Reberland language rules.

postconditions.expression: all(suffix not in forbidden_suffixes for suffix in suffixes)
postconditions.description: No two consecutive suffixes in the decomposition are identical.
The suffixes are printed in lexicographical order.
